articles.summary: STEINHAUSEN, Switzerland, April 8, 2026—Transocean Ltd. (NYSE: RIG) announced today that it will report earnings for the first quarter 2026 and issue a fleet status report on Monday, May 4, 2026, after the close of trading on the New York Stock Exchange.

articles.summary: STEINHAUSEN, Switzerland, April 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Transocean Ltd. (NYSE: RIG) (“Transocean”) today announced awards of a contract for a harsh environment semisubmersible in Norway and contract extensions for two ultra-deepwater drillships in Brazil.
